thread:
maria: Quick sync — putting together the rollout plan for FlashAttention v2->v3 interop. Goal: safe switch with measurable perf gains and clear fallbacks. TL;DR: feature flag + kernel chooser + phased canary + perf gating.
kevin: +1. Can you call out the things we need telemetry for? last time we missed a KV-cache regression signal.
rachel: We should capture these per-request metrics: model, kernel_choice, seq_len, batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency (token and request), tokens/sec, and memory alloc high-water. Also add an allocation failure counter.
maria: Agreed. I'll add those. Proposal for rollout phases:
  1) Local dev + nightlies (dev infra) — enable flag default off, unit/integration tests
  2) Canaries on dedicated infra (small pool) with synthetic traffic and replayed prod traces
  3) Gradual traffic ramp (10->50->100%) with perf gate checks (p99 and error budget)
  4) Global flip if no regressions for 72h
kevin: What are the perf gates specifically?
maria: Perf gate proposal:
  - p99 request latency no worse than +10% vs baseline
  - tokens/sec improvement >= 5% for common seq_len buckets (<=512, 512-2048)
  - no increase in allocation failures or OOMs
  - KV cache hit rate delta within +-1%
sam: Important: v3 changes kernel memory layout in some paths — that can shift eviction behavior for the paged KV cache. We should run a stress test that measures cache churn.
rachel: For cache tests, we should run replayed workload with KV cache instrumentation. Metric: average KV entries evicted per 1M tokens, and median cache retrieval latency.
ci-bot: nightly-build: flash-v3-integration branch built successfully (artifact: gs://redwood-ci/flash-v3/1744123456/)
sre-bot: deploy-candidate: Canaries scheduled for 2024-07-01 02:00 UTC against dedicated-pool-small
kevin: Kernel selection heuristics we decided on earlier: prefer fused kernels when seq_len <= 1024 and batch_size*seq_len < threshold; prefer paged when larger sequences to avoid memory blowup. Need to codify threshold and make it configurable via runtime flags.
maria: Proposed runtime flags:
  - attn.kernel_selector.strategy = "auto"|"prefer_fused"|"prefer_paged"
  - attn.kernel_selector.seq_threshold = 1024
  - attn.kernel_selector.batch_len_prod_threshold = 1_500_000
  - runtime.flags.enable_flash_v3 = true/false
kevin: Make sure the kernel selector emits events on decision path so we can roll back by rule: route requests with strategy=auto but with seq_len>___ to v2.
sam: Also add a per-model override — some models are sensitive (long-form generation) and should prefer paged even if tokens/sec lower.
maria: Right. We'll add model override map: attn.model_overrides = {"longform-v1": "prefer_paged"}
rachel: Benchmarks — please include pooled-GPU runs and single-GPU microbench. We should capture both steady-state throughput and cold-start latency (first request after model load). Also include KV warm vs cold profiles.
kevin: Example bench commands (useful for canary run):
```
# microbench single GPU
python tools/bench_attn.py --model gpt-3-small --kernel auto --batch 8 --seq 512 --iters 1000 --kv-warm

# pooled benchmark
python tools/bench_pool.py --pool dedicated-pool-small --trace replay/2024-06-30.json --concurrency 200
```
maria: Good. Add automated smoke assertions in bench harness that fail the CI if p99 regresses >10%.
ci-bot: perf-check: bench_attn.py results uploaded to perf-dashboard (run_id=1744123456) — baseline vs candidate diffs pending
sam: About fallbacks: plan is to allow in-flight fallback per-request when memory alloc fails or p99 spikes: selector should mark kernel unhealthy with TTL (e.g., 10m) and route to fallback kernel (v2 fused) until healthy again.
rachel: We need a graceful behavior for streaming responses — ensure chunked decoding unaffected by kernel swap. Add unit test for stream continuity when kernel changes mid-request.
maria: Action items:
  - maria: add telemetry events & perf gates in the rollout doc (ETA: EOD)
  - kevin: implement kernel_selector events + model_overrides (ETA: +2 days)
  - sam: create KV churn stress test and eviction metrics (ETA: +3 days)
  - rachel: add bench harness smoke checks and stream continuity test (ETA: +3 days)
  - ci-bot/sre-bot: schedule canary and run replay trace
kevin: One open Q — quantized kernels: v3 has some new int8 paths that look faster for token generation but cause slight distribution drift. We should exclude quantized paths from first canary, or at least label them behind another flag 'attn.enable_int8_v3'.
maria: Agree. Keep quantized off for canary. We'll treat it as separate rollout after we validate float paths.
sam: Danger case to watch: tiny batch traffic (1-2) might regress due to extra overhead in v3 selector. Add microbench for batch sizes 1-4.
rachel: Also validate multi-model sharing in the pool: kernel selection must be deterministic per model + request shape to avoid noisy eviction.
maria: Thanks all. I'll post an updated rollout doc in RFC PR and tag this thread. If anyone has blockers, ping me directly. :rocket:
kevin: Thanks — added one comment on the PR about adding an alert if kernel_unhealthy_count > 5 in 5m window.
maria: noted, will add alert rule.
